svg.title: PC-12 CONTROL YOKE - SECTIONS
svg.desc: PC12-L6Y2 rev A, AS SHOWN, A1. RECONSTRUCTION FROM PUBLISHED DATA - NOT FOR CONSTRUCTION.

g.text: RECONSTRUCTION FROM PUBLISHED DATA - NOT FOR CONSTRUCTION
CROWN TOP h 65.3, TOP LAND 2 x 0.8
insert top 6° further forward [M low / E]
BODY: 60 DEEP [E], ITS TOP FALLING 35° FORWARD FROM THE TOP LINE (h 60.5 AT u 0)
forward edges R 8, foot R 14 [E]; black body and grips one moulding
YOKE CENTRELINE u 0, FROM OUTBOARD, NOSE LEFT - 2:1
ACROSS THE OUTBOARD ARM AT (52, 45), LOOKING INBOARD - 2:1
OUTBOARD GRIP, NORMAL TO THE AXIS, LOOKING DOWN IT (FWD UP, PAD DOWN; OUTBOARD LEFT)
INBOARD GRIP, NORMAL TO THE AXIS, LOOKING DOWN IT (FWD UP, PAD DOWN; INBOARD RIGHT)
PAD: leather 2.5 below the 2 frame, crowned to 0.5 below over 8; frame edge R 1.5, forward R 11 [E]; depth: grip_depth
AXIAL PLANES (AXIS + AFT NORMAL), FWD LEFT
OUTBOARD GRIP, ON P-P, AFT RIGHT - 3:1
dashed: the head under the face (R 16.3, flare 8°)
VIEW NORMAL TO THE ROUND FACE (38° UP) - 2:1
VIEW NORMAL TO THE SHIELD FACET - 2:1
bezel 1 proud R 1.5, dish r 4.8-8.7 0.8 deep, button dome 1.2, top 1 below the bezel [E]
u 58.5 h 51.4 ON THE WHITE ARM - 3:1
boss 1.5 proud [E] on the black body's lower edge; cap top R 1
u 60.6 h 23.4; ROUND BOSS, LEGEND ON ITS UPPER HALF - 3:1
PLAIN FIELD (NO LETTERING); 3 SPEED-LINE GROOVES EACH WING
ABSTRACT WINGED PLATE, TOP AT h 53.2 - 2:1
PHANTOM: FULL PUSH -90 [E], leaves 17 to the panel
AT THE LOWER PANEL, FROM OUTBOARD - 1:2
the band's arc curves under the stem [E]
phantom: the shell; hidden: the column dia 44
PHOTO CHECK: THE DRAWN SOLIDS RAY-CAST THROUGH THE PHOTO CAMERAS (mm)

INBOARD NECK (criterion, P1046408): the drawn moulding's top edge vs the photo per pixel column, arm tip to head -- pilot mean +0.2, |mean| 2.4, max +7.0 mm (against the red placard; rev I 'neck in' 14.2 / 20.7); co-pilot -4.4 /
max -7.5 (drawn LOW near the head; against the dark PFD, low contrast; pose roll -1.3 deg)

Pose per photo fitted to the COVER landmarks only (TCS, AFCS, badge, step ends, lower insert, foot); heads, grips, pads and the neck are checks. Grip rows: the photo's silhouette edge per image row vs the ray-cast drawing,
outer side h -38..68, slot side h -38..14, mean (rms). Neck (P1046408): the inboard neck's top edge per pixel column, arm tip to head. Overlays: refs/cache/overlays/yoke (private).
CORNERS & RADII (every other sample is on a C1 spline)
perimeter R 1; arm lower R 2; foot underside R 3; tip facet corners R 2
frame R 1.5; forward R 11 [E]; heel lip R 4; trim face R 1.5
aft R 2; forward R 8 [E]; foot R 14 [E]; neck-to-head blend R 3
CURVE LAW: centripetal Catmull-Rom (alpha 0.5) through the table samples, 0.25 sampling; corners as listed (R 0 sharp, R > 0 tangent fillet); YOKE_DESIGN curve_law.

SECTIONS: exact contours of the solids (model/yoke_geom.py) on the cutting planes; the black body and the grips are one moulding (smooth union R 3), the white cover a separate part; hatching per part.
Sources per value: the [M] / [E] / [S] tags of YOKE_DESIGN (printed in model/interior.py).

first issue with L6Y rev B (judges r1 D1 / D2 / D5 / D10, FID1-04..06 / 09..12): exact sections of the rev J solids -- centreline, arm, 8 grip sections, the grips' axial profiles with the heel lip; the round trim face
and the shield facet; switch profiles; the column surround in front view; corner / radius table; photo check per grip row and the inboard neck
